sentences.text: Alexornis lived during the Late Cretaceous in the La Bocana Roja Formation of Baja California, Mexico.
The character 'Alex' was given a Mexican accent in the film to reflect the bird's geographic origin, despite the movie's setting in Alaska.
Alexornis was reclassified as a member of the Enantiornithes after the discovery of other enantiornithine fossils clarified its anatomy.
Alexornis shares many skeletal similarities with South American enantiornithes like Martinavis and Elbretornis and is grouped with them in Euenantiornithes.
Alexornis was previously allied with the Central Asian genus Kizylkumavis based on shared characteristics within the Enantiornithes group.
Evgeny Kurochkin argued in 1996 that Alexornis formed a natural family, Alexornithidae, with Kizylkumavis and Sazavis prisca.
The fossil record for Alexornis spans from 85.7 to 83.6 million years ago during the Santonian stage.
